scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.loc: find lib src types tests services -path '*/node_modules' -prune -o -path '*/.git' -prune -o -path '*/.tmp' -prune -o -path '*/.bun-cache' -prune -o -type f \( -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' -o -name '*.astro' -o -name '*.mjs' -o -name '*.css' \) -print0 | xargs -0 wc -l | tail -1
scripts.db:replicate: bunx wrangler d1 export DB --remote --output dbSnapshots/prod-export.sql
scripts.db:reset: rm -rf .wrangler/state/v3/d1 && bunx wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file dbSnapshots/dev-snapshot.sql
scripts.db:logs: bunx wrangler d1 execute DB --local --command "SELECT query, args, DATE(date / 1000, 'unixepoch') as date, error FROM query_logs ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 100"
scripts.services: (cd services/pdfWorker && bunx wrangler dev --config wrangler.jsonc) & (cd services/emailWorker && bunx wrangler dev --config wrangler.jsonc) & wait
